test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Town K is to the north of Town L. Town M is to the east of Town K. Town N is to the south of Town M. Town O is to the west of Town N. Town L is to the south-west of Town O. What is the position of Town K with respect to Town O?
solution:
Given:

Town K is north of Town L.

Town M is east of K.

Town N is south of M.

Town O is west of N.

Town L is south-west of Town O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eb3ba2e6f2029eccb2d2ec3d922b553e6ee0817c2f74660a8c2ac73f46d54bb.png] 

Therefore, K is south-west of O.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
